title: Understanding and Resolving Singularities in 3D Dirichlet Boundary Problems
summary: We introduce a two-phase approximation method designed to resolve singularities in three-dimensional harmonic Dirichlet problems. The approach utilizes the classical Green's function representation, decomposing the function into its singular and regular components. The singular phase employs Green's formula with the singular part, for which we show that it induces the necessary singularities in the solution.
